\n\n\n\n\n\n"}; const viewer=document.getElementById('viewer'); const loading=document.getElementById('loading'); function decodeRoute(){ let h=location.hash.replace(/^#/,''); if(h.startsWith('route=')) h=h.slice(6); try{h=decodeURIComponent(h)}catch(e){} if(!h) return 'index.html'; return h; } function normalizeRoute(r){ r=r.replace(/^\.\/+/,''); if(r==='index' || r==='/' || r==='') return 'index.html'; return r; } function render(){ const route=normalizeRoute(decodeRoute()); const key=Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(PAGES,route)?route:'index.html'; loading.classList.add('show'); // srcdoc keeps the entire project inside this single file. viewer.srcdoc=PAGES[key]; viewer.onload=()=>loading.classList.remove('show'); document.title='abdomousa'; } window.abdoNavigate=function(route){ location.hash='route='+encodeURIComponent(route); }; window.addEventListener('hashchange',render); render();
